learning_outcomes.text: At the end of the course, students are able to implement a larger object-oriented and modular programming project using C++.

They understand how to design aspects of a task with various programming possibilities (loops, recursions, if-statements, functions, classes) and also to create or select and use suitable data types for the respective application area, such as arrays, pointers, classes.
Using analytical skills learned in the lecture, students can comprehend programs, evaluate their execution, and improve or correct them.

syllabus_topics: Simple and more complex data types: strings, arrays (one and two-dimensional), pointers
Problem solving through iterations and recursion
Methods for converting tasks into program code
assessment_rules: A team project assignment (PA/1S) consisting of a larger programming task with a report and demonstration of the project. Evaluation considers: short demonstration, ability to explain the code, report, program execution, and the programming itself. Prerequisite for examination (XP): passing 2 out of 2 tests and presenting the project sketch.
